Fix the build error in my project.
The build error could be caused by many things. Let me explain the common causes of build failures.
Build systems typically have a compilation step and a linking step. Errors can occur in either.
In the compilation step, the compiler checks syntax and types. In the linking step, the linker resolves symbols.
Common causes include missing dependencies, incorrect paths, version mismatches, and configuration errors.
To properly diagnose this, one should examine the build log carefully and identify the specific error message.
The build process can be complex and depends on the specific tools being used.
